product_metadata.title: Amazing Roo 6x8 Black Picture Frame Set of 6, Display 6 by 8 inch Pictures for Wall and Table Top Photo Frames
features: Dimension: The outline size of each 6x8 black frame is about 8.8x10.8 inch(22.5x27.5 cm). Not provided white matte to fit a 6x8 picture, photo and image.

Contemporary Style: Our 6x8 picture frame set includes 6 packs. The black frame is made of synthetic wood material, which may looks like plastic but not plastic one. They are sturdy and the black color is neutral enough to fit with anything. Each frame comes with a clear piece of glass through which your photos will be beautifully presented.

Wall Mount or Table Top Display(Vertically or Horizontally): Each 6x8 frame comes with hanging hardware and an easel on the back. You can use the frame in various ways, such as hang it on the wall portrait/ landscape or place it on the table.

Easy to Install: Each frame comes with easy open tabs on back that are “springy”, making it easy to lock them into the frame groove on the back. Such design allows you to load and show your 6 by 8 inch pictures quickly.

Multiple Usage: Our set of black frames are easy to use with a minimalistic style, perfect for most 6 by 8 inch photos/artworks. They will look amazing whether you hang it in your hallways, stairways, or other walls.
description: Black frame size is 8.8x10.8 inch. Quantity: 6 pieces Easy to use and great for your most beloved memories get put on display for others to see in the picture frames. Each 6x8 frames comes with hanging hardware and an easel on the back, which display for wall mounting and table top, both do the job whether for horizontally or vertically.
